description: Believes they have achieved a deeper understanding of the Dao than they actually possess. Blind spots in their foundation.
Has trained in both internal and external styles from an early age. Excellent balance between force and technique.
The body has adapted to centuries of toxin exposure. Immune to most poisons, but Qi tends towards a corrosive quality.
The core energy centre is unusually stable and resistant to disruption. Hard to damage, but also slower to advance.
The core is cracked or partially sealed. Cultivation advancement is permanently impaired.
Rare harmonic alignment of all twelve major meridians. Qi circulates without effort and accumulates rapidly.
Qi flows in an unorthodox direction through their channels. Incompatible with standard sect manuals but devastatingly powerful once mastered.
